title: The four fact drills: + − × ÷ facts on the fact template, fact rows 5 to 10 columns, and ÷ facts in three notations

template.also: Fact rows (`js/modules/sheet/roles/fact-rows.js`) redraw every item: + − × and the ÷ sign stacked on `fact`; div_facts' Long division on `division` (`cells/long-division.js`, the compact fact-rows bracket VA-60a) and Fraction on `equation` (`cells/equation.js`, the fact-rows fraction with its answer line under it). `screen-cell.js` draws the same cells on the practice card, online worksheet and quiz.

summary: Family card for the four fact drills. Each deals one two-number fact per boxed cell from a fact set (a constant, the band, the table) and prints it on the kit `fact` template on every page type; on the fact-rows page (5 to 10 columns) every fact is redrawn at the column ladder's digit. div_facts has five written forms (`divForm`): Standard, Long division, Fraction, Vertical and Mix; on fact rows all three notations - the ÷ sign, the fraction and the bracket - reach the full 10 columns (owner ruling 2026-10-30).
teaches: Recall the basic facts: addition and subtraction within 20 (1.OA.6, 2.OA.2), multiplication and division within 100 / 144 (3.OA.7). A fact is recalled, not worked: no regroup boxes, no work rows, one answer. "Facts to N" bounds the ANSWER for + (the sum) and the number started from for − (the minuend); the × / ÷ band is the largest product or dividend (10 x 10 or 12 x 12).
research: From repo sources: PAGE_TYPES 4.1 (fact rows, PT-FRW-*) and 4.2 (fact probe), WORKSHEET_DESIGN_STANDARD §10 (VA-1..VA-5, VA-60..VA-66, VA-70, VA-71), TY-22 / TY-30 (the fact ladder), design/catalogue/{addition,subtraction,multiplication,division}.md and the div_facts forms rounds (critic R1 / R2). Reference sites (MathWorksheets4Kids timed fact drills, Math-Drills 100-fact pages, IXL fact fluency) deal 50-100 facts a page in vertical or horizontal form; our density is the fact-rows table, never theirs.
problemTypes: vertical fact (+ − ×, and ÷ stacked): two numbers, the operator in its own track, the 1.5 pt rule, the open answer row — the core item
horizontal fact ("8 + 7 = __"): its own section, at most 4 columns (VA-71)

÷ fact in its written form (div_facts `divForm`): Standard across, Long division (the bracket, quotient above), Fraction (the dividend over the divisor, = __), Vertical (stacked), Mix (one third each of Standard, Long division and Fraction)
missing-number facts belong to the cloze / unknown skills, not these drills
progression: a single constant ("Add 3", "Multiply by 4") before a mixed set; 0 and 1 facts as their own constants
the band grows: + / − facts to 10, then to 20; × / ÷ to 10 x 10, then 12 x 12
the fact drills move from the Independent page (5 x 5 at S, 4 x 5 at M, 3 x 4 at L) to fact rows (10 / 6 / 5 columns at S / M / L) as recall becomes fluent
÷: one written form a page (Standard first, then the bracket and the fraction), Mix last

drawing.sizes: Fact rows: the column ladder sets the digit (5: 28 pt, 6: 24, 8: 18, 10: 16; TY-30), Auto 10 / 6 / 5 columns at S / M / L (PT-FRW-2), tracks 0.72 em and T = 3 (TY-22), rows from the cell's need (table 4.1, stretch cap 1.3). Other page types: the fact template at the column count the page chose, its measured height (VA-70) with no extra dense room.
notes: ÷ on fact rows (owner ruling 2026-10-30, PT-FRW-9): the ÷ sign stacked with a 0.62 em operator track beside a 3-digit dividend (15.7 mm at 16 pt); the fraction with "=" beside its bar and the answer line under it (15.0 mm); the bracket on 0.54-1.0 em tracks, a 0.17-0.45 em gutter, centred on its ink (15.8 mm). Every form: ink + 1 mm clear each side (FIT_CLEAR_MM), never below 16 pt.
Standard ("12 ÷ 3 = __") prints stacked on fact rows: the across sentence of 144 ÷ 12 is 28 mm at 16 pt and cannot reach 5 columns at the rung (PT-FRW-7).
The key writes every answer in place, at the digit size, in the key ink (AK-1, AK-2, INK-31): under the rule (stacked), on the line (fraction), over the vinculum (bracket).
Screen: the practice card, online worksheet and quiz draw the item's own form (never the fact-rows narrowing), one answer input in the printed place (SCC-T15).

ruleGroups.title: Fact rows and ÷ facts at 10 columns (quoted)
The fact cell, tracks, ladder and labels
Keys, screen and the quality bar
Cited by critics on this family's findings (ids only)

ownerRulings.ruling: ÷ facts reach the full 10 columns on the fact-rows page in ALL THREE notations - the fraction a/b, the ÷ sign and the long-division bracket - at Size S Auto and whenever the teacher picks 10 columns at any size. Digits never shrink below the Size S fact digit (16 pt); the real-fit gate (ink + 1 mm clear each side) and VA-2's operator track still apply; 5 / 6 / 8 columns and Mix still work; the key renders every form.
ownerRulings.source: Lane D restart brief (work order item 3, design/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md); PAGE_TYPES PT-FRW-9

ownerRulings.ruling: How a division fact is written is one choice for the page (`divForm`): Standard, Long division, Fraction, Vertical, or Mix (one third each of the first three, blocks of three shuffled by seed). The same kit cell on paper and on every screen host.
CL-4b on fact rows: a fact starts at the top of its box; a cell whose pupil writes ABOVE the problem (the division bracket) is centred down the box.
"Within N" / "facts to N" bounds the ANSWER (the sum, the minuend, the product, the dividend), never the operands alone.

misconceptions.error: subtracting the smaller digit from the larger whatever the order (13 − 5 read as 5 − 3 in the ones)
counting on / back from the wrong number (starting the count on the first number: 8 + 3 = 10)
a neighbouring multiple (7 x 8 = 54, 6 x 9 = 56) or the sum for the product
÷ written the other way round: the divisor divided by the dividend, or the bracket read as dividend outside (12 ) 3)

options: Declared today (skill-options.js): add_facts / sub_facts / mult_facts / div_facts each have the constant (fact set), the band, the support cue (touch dots, tiles, frame, line, skip strip, array, think box); + − × the notation (stacked / across); div_facts `divForm` (standard / long / fraction / vertical / mix) in place of the notation.
Fact rows' own controls live on the page, not the skill: Columns (Auto / 5 / 6 / 8 / 10), size, labels, Day bands.

Owner rule 2026-10-17 (a distinct option is also a findable skill): `divForm` long and fraction are candidate presets ("Division facts: long division form", "Division facts as fractions"); open question 3.

openQuestions.q: On fact rows div_facts Standard ("12 ÷ 3 = __") prints as the stacked ÷ fact, the same drawing as Vertical: the across sentence of a 3-digit dividend cannot reach 5 columns at its rung. Keep it, or keep a 3-column across page for Standard when the teacher leaves Columns on Auto?
openQuestions.recommended: Keep it stacked: fact rows are one vertical form (PT 4.1 purpose, PT-FRW-3), the owner asked for the ÷ sign in 10 columns, and the across form still prints on every other page type and on screen.

openQuestions.q: div_facts Mix on fact rows puts the bracket (answer above) beside stacked ÷ and fraction facts (answer below) on one page, which VA-65 forbade for + − × stacks. Accept it for Mix only?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes, for Mix only (the owner's own option deals the three notations on one page); every other section keeps the bracket in its own section (PT-FRW-6).

openQuestions.q: The 10-column bracket needs 0.54 em digit tracks (0.17 mm between the ink of two wide digits such as "44") and a near-straight arc (0.4 mm bow) to fit 12 ) 144 with 1 mm clear each side at 16 pt. Accept, or let the bracket page clamp to 8 columns when the band reaches 12 x 12?
openQuestions.recommended: Accept for 10 columns (the ruling) and let the critic judge legibility at 100 %; the 8-column page keeps 0.58 em tracks.

openQuestions.q: Owner rule 2026-10-17: are `divForm` long and fraction distinct enough to be preset skills ("Divide: long-division form", "Divide: fraction form")?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes for long division (4.NBT.6 / WRM Y4 short division uses the bracket); fraction form stays an option (6.NS / 5.NF.3 is taught by the fraction skills).

openQuestions.q: Independent page at L keeps 3 x 4 = 12 facts in 57 mm rows (33 % under the answer zone) because the L ceiling of standard problems is 12 (12.1). Raise the facts' class to "short" (L 16: 3 x 5) in print-sheet's footprintClass?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes, in the layout lane (print-sheet.js / layout.js are not this lane's files): facts are one-symbol answers, which 12.1 lets reach 16.
